a Choose the correct answer :
° 1. The plant's ........... anchor it in the soil.
a. leaves b. stems c. roots d. flowers

nutrients. (Cairo 2024)
a. vessels b. root hairs c. stomata d. flowers
* 3. The tubes that are responsible for moving water and nutrients up the plant's
stem are called ..........
a. roots. b. xylem. c. leaves. d. flowers.
° 4.......... plant has climb stem. (Gharbia 2023)
| a. Potato b. Tomato c. Vine d. Pine

| a. climb b. tuber c. runner d. wood
© 6. Potato plant has ........... stem. (Cairo 2024)
| a. upright b. climb c. tuber d. runner
* 7. Stomata are present on plant's .......... to allow air to pass through them. (Giza 2024)
| a. roots b. stems c. leaves d. flowers
° 8........... can make their own food. (South Sinai 2023)
a. Plants only b. Animals only
c. Humans only d. Plants and some animals

| a. Potato b. Pine c. Acacia d. Grapes

| a. roots. b. stems. c. leaves. d. flowers.
